subject.title: [Feature]: Show session and requester context in macOS exec approval popup

question: Which requester metadata may the macOS native exec approval popup disclose beyond the existing session key, and how should sensitive channel/account/thread/sender values be redacted or omitted?
rationale: The session row is a narrow parity fix, but the requested channel/sender/requester fields can expose private context in a native OS popup and need maintainer-approved disclosure policy before implementation.

options.title: Stage session first
options.body: Add the existing sessionKey display now and defer channel, sender, thread, account, and reason fields until a disclosure policy is approved.

options.title: Define full metadata policy first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose the exact Channel/Sender/Thread fields and redaction behavior, then land the complete native-popup update together.

options.title: Limit scope to session only
options.body: Treat channel/sender/tool-reason display as out of scope and close the broader requester-context request after the Session row lands.

recommendation.title: Stage session first
recommendation.body: Add the existing sessionKey display now and defer channel, sender, thread, account, and reason fields until a disclosure policy is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest combined signal from macOS exec approval history and prior review context on this issue.
